The '''Haashimut caverns''' were located under the [[Color/Legends|red]] skies of [[Haashimut]]. The caverns were used by the Jedi of a nearby [[Jedi enclave (Haashimut)|enclave]] to meditate or train their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]. The walls of the caves were sculpted over the generations of Jedi.
